note: Three uploaded-reference briefs backed by the first real uploads in this checkout (renders/references/mogra/, manifest.json). They exist to prove the composite path end to end: the product pixels must come from the upload, only the scene is generated, and fidelity `exact` routes every one of them through CompositeGenerator. Constraints are the proof-run size of the render lane (1536 px scenes); the production catalog asks for 2000 px. Background is free where the scene is generated, because a generated scene cannot promise a flat white sweep; the fidelity verdict is the printed-text check, not the backdrop.
